Ending credits from my cartoon, DANDYS WORLD: COSMO'S PUNISHMENT
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Si_jsUebYIQ
It's Easter Sunday and Astro has been let out of the hospital after 2 neferious toons (Sprout and Cosmo) broke into his house in the middle of the night and brutalized him. Dandy knows that these toons must be punished.

If you like what I do please consider supporting me over on patreon and following me on X/Twitter!
